mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paper_info WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT p.id AS paperId, p.paper_title AS paperTitle, u.real_name AS studentName, u.username AS studentNo, COALESCE(p.teacher_name, tu.real_name) AS advisorName, p.teacher_id AS teacherId, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR), NOW()) AS overdueDays, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR) AS deadline, p.paper_status AS paperStatus, CASE WHEN r.last_remind_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reminded, r.last_remind_time AS lastRemindTime FROM paper_info p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.student_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = p.teacher_id AND tu.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT paper_id, MAX(create_time) AS last_remind_time FROM paper_reminder_log GROUP BY paper_id ) r ON r.paper_id = p.id WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR) < NOW() AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR), NOW()) >= 1 AND p.paper_status IN ('checking','auditing','reviewing','mid_defense','final_defense')
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR), NOW()) BETWEEN 1 AND 2
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR), NOW()) BETWEEN 3 AND 6
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR), NOW()) >= 7
AND ( p.paper_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.teacher_name, tu.real_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY overdueDays DESC, deadline ASC

SELECT t.bucketKey, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR), NOW()) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '1' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR), NOW()) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN '3' ELSE '7' END AS bucketKey FROM paper_info p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR) < NOW() AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, DATE_ADD(p.submit_time, INTERVAL #{slaHours} HOUR), NOW()) >= 1 AND p.paper_status IN ('checking','auditing','reviewing','mid_defense','final_defense') ) t GROUP BY t.bucketKey
